title: Three Row Round Flex
metaDescription: Three rows of round brilliant diamonds in continuous parallel — the Bez Ambar Flex, 18K white gold or platinum. Ref. B5993. Los Angeles.
copy: Round brilliants are cut to maximize the light returned to the eye. In a single row they do that in sequence — in three rows set side by side, they do it simultaneously across the full width of the wrist. The Three Row was built to hold round brilliants in continuous parallel, each stone facing forward in the Bez Ambar Flex setting so the movement of the wrist becomes part of the piece. Three rows because at this stone count, the width is the point.

specs.label: Gem Stone
specs.body: White diamond · Round brilliant — Natural. Three rows of round brilliants set in parallel on the Bez Ambar Flex. No clasp.
